checks_run.procedure: Rerun my round-7 repro unchanged (zz-sec-r7-probe.test.ts), on a disposable PostgreSQL 16, in both locale settings. Then read the fix in request-encoding.ts, server.ts and hooks.ts against the Fastify 5.6.1 sources (contentTypeParser.js addContentTypeParser/rawBody/getDefaultJsonParser).
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 29772 (LANG unset) | 29773 (LANG=C.UTF-8) pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r7-probe.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r8-probe.test.ts --reporter=verbose
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe-r8 at 4053630c, Node 22.22.2, PostgreSQL 16 (SQL_ASCII and UTF8 clusters)
checks_run.expected: B1 and B2: ill-formed bytes with a Content-Length get a declared 4xx, never a 500, including before authentication. B3: chunked bytes are never stored or audited as U+FFFD. The bodyLimit, raw-byte length check and prototype-poisoning protection are preserved.
checks_run.actual: zz-sec-r7-probe: 14/14 pass in both runs (round 7: 12 pass, 2 fail). B1: ED A0 80 / FF / C3 give 400 validation.json at pointer '', with no charter and no audit row; control 201. B2: unauthenticated over a socket, 400 validation.json; control 401. B3: chunked gives 400, nothing stored, no U+FFFD. By code: the parser inherits the server bodyLimit (contentTypeParser.js:344), counts raw bytes with asBuffer (:246), uses a fresh fatal TextDecoder, strips one BOM, then calls Fastify's default JSON parser ('error','error'). FST_ERR_CTP_INVALID_CONTENT_LENGTH is mapped to 400. F-DG2-290 is CLOSED_VERIFIED (see the verifications sidecar). Exit status 1 belongs to the shared vitest invocation and comes solely from the R6 test of the round-8 file, recorded under SEC-R8-03. Every test of this check passed.

checks_run.procedure: Round-8 adversarial probe zz-sec-r8-probe.test.ts R1-R5 and R7-R10: every ill-formed UTF-8 class in both framings; BOM variants; charset and media-type variants; prototype poisoning through the new parser; the raw-byte body limit; query-string pointers and edge cases; X-File-Name ordering against authorization; a real-socket chunked request with no session; a U+FFFD sweep and an error-log count. Every response was checked against the OpenAPI contract.
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 29772 | 29773 pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r8-probe.test.ts (same invocation as SEC-R8-01)
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe-r8 at 4053630c, Node 22.22.2, PostgreSQL 16 (SQL_ASCII and UTF8 clusters)
checks_run.expected: Every path behaves as declared: a declared 400 or the success status, never a 500, never a rewritten byte stored, no error-level log, no pollution, and no 400 oracle before authorization.
checks_run.actual: R1-R5 and R7-R10 pass in both runs. R1: all 10 classes in both framings give 400 validation.json, with nothing stored and 0 error logs. R2: one BOM gives 201; two BOMs, BOM+FF, a BOM alone and UTF-16 give 400; a U+FEFF inside a string is kept. R3: charset parameters never switch the decoder; other +json types give 400 content_type. R4: __proto__, escaped __proto__ and constructor give 400, not polluted. R5: 1,048,629 bytes / 349,571 characters gives 400 body_too_large in both framings. R7: /query/q, /query, /query/a~0b~1c; a stray % gives 400; health with %FF gives a declared 400; 401 precedes; unmatched 404. R8: a non-editor gets 403 for x%FF.csv. R9: 400. R10: 0 U+FFFD rows. Exit status 1 belongs to the shared vitest invocation and comes solely from R6, recorded under SEC-R8-03. Every test of this check passed.

checks_run.procedure: Probe R6: uploadEvidenceContent (contract: application/octet-stream only) with octet-stream, text/plain and application/json bodies in both framings. Compare the downloaded bytes and the stored sha256 with the bytes sent. Rerun R6 alone at the round-7 candidate 90439483 as a baseline.
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 29772 | 29773 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r8-probe.test.ts (R6); baseline: $TMPDIR/probe-r7base at 90439483, with-pg.sh 29774 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r8-probe.test.ts -t R6
checks_run.expected: The stored evidence is exactly the bytes sent. A media type other than application/octet-stream gets a declared 4xx and is never stored rewritten. Never a 500.
checks_run.actual: octet-stream (both framings): stored and downloaded byte for byte, sha256 matches. text/plain, chunked, bytes 53796effc30aeda08041: 200, stored as 53796eefbfbdefbfbd0aefbfbdefbfbdefbfbd41 (U+FFFD), with the sha256 of the rewritten bytes. application/json {"a":1} or [1,2,3]: 500 internal (undeclared) plus an error log. application/json "Synthetic": 200, with the decoded text stored. text/plain with a Content-Length: 400 malformed_request (a 500 at 90439483). The baseline shows the same rewrite and 500, so this predates BE13. Raised as F-DG2-320 (Low, non-mandatory).

checks_run.procedure: Read the product diff 90439483..cf3446e4 (24 files) and the full files it touches: request-encoding.ts, server.ts, hooks.ts, platform/index.ts, evidence/routes.ts (decodeFileName), harness.ts (logStream), the openapi.yaml amendment, ADR-0007 §5b, platform-statuses.ts and contract.test.ts. Scan the added lines for risky patterns. Count the 429 refs and operations.
checks_run.command: git diff 90439483..cf3446e4 -- . ':!docs/delivery'; grep scan of '^+' lines (diff-scan.log); git diff ... -- docs/api/openapi.yaml | grep '^[+-]' | sort | uniq -c; count of operationId and RateLimited 429 refs in openapi.yaml
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-r8; Fastify 5.6.1 sources in node_modules
checks_run.expected: No weakening of bodyLimit, media-type checks or prototype-poisoning protection; the octet-stream upload unchanged; no secrets, CDN or eval; an additive contract amendment; a rule test that derives statuses from routes and cannot be trivially satisfied.
checks_run.actual: No weakening found. The JSON parser is registered once on the root and inherits bodyLimit; the octet-stream parser is untouched. decodeFileName refuses an undecodable escape only after openWrite (scope and ownership), so there is no oracle (probe R8: 403). Contract: 158 '+ "429": RateLimited' lines plus one reworded description; nothing removed; 161 operations, 161 with 429. platformStatuses derives 400/401/403/409/428/429 from the route's declared access, the method and the IfMatch parameter, and pins 5 operations; the live sweep checks all 161 operations at 429. The out-of-contract classes (500, 408, unmatched 404, pre-routing parser 400) are justified in ADR-0007 §5b. /healthz?x is counted by the limiter because the allowList compares the raw URL (D-068): it affects only the caller's own IP bucket and is declared, so it is an observation, not a defect. The diff scan matched only a test regex, a .invalid placeholder issuer and the collision check's throwaway 'ok' server.

checks_run.procedure: Review tests/qa/support/pg-port.sh, port-collision-check.sh and the five harnesses that source it (with-pg.sh, with-stack.sh, qa-stack.sh, a18-clean-start.sh, clean-start-local.sh) for security regressions: bind addresses, secret handling, foreign-listener confusion, unsafe eval or indirection, and unbounded retry.
checks_run.command: cat tests/qa/support/pg-port.sh; git diff 90439483..cf3446e4 -- <the five harnesses> | grep -iE 'password|secret|token|chmod|0.0.0.0|listen|auth|trust|curl|eval|rm -rf|umask'
checks_run.expected: No new exposure: PostgreSQL bound to 127.0.0.1 only; secrets unchanged; a foreign server on the port is never mistaken for ours; retries bounded and logged.
checks_run.actual: PostgreSQL still binds 127.0.0.1 only, with no unix socket. Readiness is tied to our own postmaster's log offset, and a port that already accepts connections is skipped, so a foreign listener cannot be mistaken for ours. The pool (25000-31999) is validated numerically and excluded from the ephemeral range. Retries are bounded (MTH_PORT_RETRIES, default 10) and logged; STRICT mode returns BLOCKED; there is no eval. Secret handling in clean-start-local.sh is unchanged by the diff: the 0644 secret files and the API's 0.0.0.0 bind (main.ts) predate it and are throwaway local-harness values. My own clusters used ports 29761-29781 (below 32768) with no collision.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-290 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. My round-7 repro passes 14/14 in both locales, and an extended probe of 10 ill-formed classes, BOMs, charsets, prototype poisoning, the raw-byte body limit and query edge cases shows only declared responses. No regression from BE13, ARCH-03 or DEVOPS3. Every required check ran and passed: build, typecheck, lint, openapi-lint, no-cdn, format, unit 691/691 on Node 22 and 24 and under load, integration 547/547 in both locales, the AUD-403 sweep and historical DG0/DG1. One new Low, non-mandatory finding: F-DG2-320. uploadEvidenceContent accepts text/plain and application/json bodies its contract does not declare. Chunked text/plain stores ill-formed bytes as U+FFFD (200), and a JSON object or array gives an undeclared 500. It predates BE13. Its check, SEC-R8-03, is recorded as FAIL.
